name: RoomLab
summary: Turns a photo of a room into a photorealistic redesign, virtual staging or a short video, using credits.
description: RoomLab is a web app for interior redesign and virtual home staging: you start from a photo of a room, change furniture or materials, tidy a space or furnish a property, and can also generate short videos. The official English plan page (checked from Europe/Madrid) prices a first free image, then a one-time Personal plan at €9.99 for 150 credits (about 15 images or 3 videos, no renewal), and monthly Pro €14.99, Ultra €39.99 and Premium €89.99 (yearly Pro €149 and Ultra €399 also listed; unused subscription credits are saved if you cancel). Each image uses about 10 credits, and 4K adds about 10 more. Browsers may be geo-redirected to a language path such as /es.

pricing.details: 1 free image; Personal 9.99 € one-time (150 credits); Pro 14.99 €/month, Ultra 39.99 €/month, Premium 89.99 €/month (yearly: Pro 149 €, Ultra 399 €). Official euro prices as shown in Europe/Madrid.
